info.name: AWS Control Tower Baselines Landing Zones API
AWS Control Tower Create Landing Zone

items.docs: Creates a new landing zone. This is an asynchronous operation. After you call this operation, you can check the landing zone status by calling GetLandingZone.

info.name: AWS Control Tower Delete Landing Zone

items.docs: Decommissions a landing zone. This is an asynchronous operation. After you call this operation, you can check the landing zone status by calling GetLandingZone.

info.name: AWS Control Tower Get Landing Zone

items.docs: Returns details about a landing zone. Includes status and version.

info.name: AWS Control Tower List Landing Zones

items.docs: Returns a list of landing zones in the caller's AWS account.

info.name: AWS Control Tower Update Landing Zone

items.docs: Updates an existing landing zone. This is an asynchronous operation. After you call this operation, you can check the landing zone status by calling GetLandingZone.

info.name: AWS Control Tower Reset Landing Zone

items.docs: Re-enables a landing zone after it has been decommissioned, or extends it to new regions. This is an asynchronous operation.

info.name: AWS Control Tower Get Landing Zone Operation

items.docs: Returns the status of a specified landing zone operation.

info.name: AWS Control Tower List Landing Zone Operations

items.docs: Lists all landing zone operations from the past 90 days.
